import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyDegreeComparison
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyTwistedKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesTensorPowers

/-!
# Uniform vanishing for tensor powers of a fixed twisting bundle

After a field extension, a divisor presentation of a fixed bundle identifies
the actual tensor-power Cartier quotient kernel with the module of the divisor
`n A - D`. The uniform divisor-module vanishing bound therefore applies before
the extension field and the divisor family are chosen.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

/-- A single degree bound makes the actual tensor-power twisted quotient
kernel acyclic in degree one over every extension field. -/
theorem exists_uniform_bound_tensorPow_twistQuotientKernel_hModule_one
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ],
      letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
      letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
          ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
      ∀ (A : (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor)
        (_ : (Modules.pullback (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj L ≅ divisorModules κ A)
        (n : ℕ)
        (x : DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))) {d : ℕ},
        x.HasFiberDeg d → b ≤ (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg κ A - (d : ℤ) →
        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
          (toModuleKSheafOfModules (baseChangeField C κ)
            (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap (Modules.tensorPow L n)))) 1) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_uniform_bound_hModule_one_divisorModules k C
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro κ _ _
  letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro A eA n x d hx hn
  let ep := pullbackTensorPowDivisorIso κ _ L hL A eA n
  let ek : kernel (x.twistQuotientMap (Modules.tensorPow L n)) ≅
      divisorModules (X := (baseChangeField C κ).left) κ
        (n • A - (show (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from
          x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) :=
    twistQuotientKernelIso_of_divisorIso (Modules.tensorPow L n)
      (Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial hL n) x (n • A) ep
  have hdeg : b ≤ CurveDivisor.deg κ
      (n • A - (show (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from
        x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, CurveDivisor.deg_add, CurveDivisor.deg_neg,
      CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul, x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_of_hasFiberDeg hx]
    exact hn
  let e := (toModuleKSheafOfModulesFunctor (baseChangeField C κ)).mapIso ek
  exact (Equiv.subsingleton_congr (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv e 1).toEquiv).mpr
    (hb κ _ hdeg)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
